blocks.title: A quiet line under every reply: how fast it wrote, and what it read
blocks.description: Under the latest reply, one line shows the model's live speed in tok/s and the sources behind the answer. Click a site icon to open it in your browser, or open the details for latency, a speed trend, token usage and a copyable source list.

showcase.user_prompt: Is CSS container queries safe to use in production now?
showcase.assistant_reply:
Yes — Chrome 105+, Firefox 110+ and Safari 16+ ship it, and it has been widely available since August 2025.

⏱ 118 tok/s · first token 0.8 s · 1,240 output tokens · 3 model calls
🔗 caniuse.com · developer.mozilla.org · web.dev  All 4 sources

items.title: Live while it writes
items.description: See the speed of the last two seconds and what the model is doing: thinking, writing the reply, writing tool arguments or running tools.

items.title: Settles when it's done
items.description: When the turn ends, the line switches to the turn average with the provider's real token count.

items.title: Details in one click
items.description: A steady side-by-side panel: live trend, first-token latency, call and turn averages, generation time and the token mix of the last call.

items.title: Sees numbers, not words
items.description: Vetta hands the plugin speed and usage figures only. Your messages never reach it.

items.title: Up to three, spelled out
items.description: Few sources: show each site with its own icon and domain. More than three: stack the icons and summarise as “caniuse.com and 4 sources”.

items.title: Opens where you expect
items.description: Click a site icon and the page opens in your default browser, not in a side panel.

items.title: Copy as Markdown
items.description: The details list every source with its title and whether the reply cited it or a tool opened it — copy all of them as a numbered Markdown list.

items.title: Icons fetched locally
items.description: Site icons are requested through Vetta itself, never handed to a third-party icon service.

items.title: Live speed
items.description: Output tokens in the last 2 seconds. Drops toward 0 when the model pauses, so you can tell a stall from a slow model.

items.title: Turn average
items.description: Output tokens ÷ time spent generating. Tool execution and waiting for the first token are not counted.

items.title: First-token latency
items.description: Time from sending the request to the first thinking, text or tool-argument token.

items.title: ≈ estimates
items.description: While streaming, tokens are estimated from received text; real counts replace them when each call ends.

items.title: Install Vetta Reply HUD
items.description: Requires Vetta 0.6.32 or newer. Nothing to configure.

items.title: Chat as usual
items.description: In regular and project conversations, the line appears under the latest reply.

items.title: Click what you need
items.description: A site icon opens that page; “all sources” opens the full list with copy.

blocks.title: Good to know
blocks.content: Team conversations do not report speed yet, so the speed line stays hidden there. The trend chart covers the current turn while the conversation is open, and the source list is rebuilt each turn.
